scope: Seeded mashup pure model, source identities, recipe replay, and independent review of UI transaction boundaries
method: Source review plus actual bundled-model contract tests; no browser acceptance is claimed

findings.issue: Canonical sorted source objects caused donated pattern-cell and instrument property insertion order to differ from ProjectStore reopening order, changing the packed authoring record on a later build.
findings.evidence: Integration agent compared full pre/post Save and reopen records and isolated those two object families. Actual World ROMs differed before the correction.
findings.correction: Model now uses ProjectStore.prepareLoad output ordering for patterns and instruments before hashing the result and running preflight. Model test verifies exact JSON ordering, while integration retains its actual rebuilt-ROM equality oracle.
findings.state: Corrected in source; final bundled integration gate required

findings.issue: Shuffle unlocked changed only the seed while explicit source selectors remained fixed. Loading a saved recipe populated all selectors with resolved IDs, making unlocked domains remain fixed after shuffle.
findings.reproduction: Load a saved recipe with unlocked domain choices, then invoke Shuffle unlocked. Prior implementation retained each explicit selected donor irrespective of the new seed.
findings.correction: UI agent reset unlocked selectors to random before shuffle and retained locked choices. A new UI regression covers recipe load followed by shuffle.
findings.state: Corrected by UI owner; final bundled UI gate required

reviewed_guards: Detached frozen source snapshots use canonical JSON SHA-256 identities; source names and original file whitespace are not identity inputs.
Source byte and pool bounds are enforced; recipe replay requires exact source identities, selected IDs, version and result identity.
Source normalizer repairs to critical scene and Audio data are refused before donor selection.
Custom assembly in the base is refused. Donor code and original ROM images are not executed or copied into the base.
UI Apply replays the exact recipe, verifies current project epoch and full serialized content, and compares a whitelist-built expected candidate.
UI commits only selected target scene graphics/palettes, changed Audio fields and declared actor instance variations, with one history snapshot.
Fallible post-commit refreshes happen after dirty marking; they do not masquerade as an uncommitted mutation.
World preflight compiles detached bytes. Other generated runtimes explicitly retain pending full-build capacity checks. Neither proves browser, audio-listening or hardware acceptance.
